name: academy-platform-monorepo
description: Multi-tenant Online Academy SaaS Platform - Monorepo

scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:platform" "npm run dev:academy"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:platform && npm run build:academy
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:platform && npm run lint:academy
scripts.type-check:all: cd frontend-platform && npm run type-check && cd ../frontend-academy && npm run type-check && cd ../shared && npm run type-check
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend-platform && npm install && cd ../frontend-academy && npm install && cd ../shared && npm install
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules backend/node_modules frontend-platform/node_modules frontend-academy/node_modules shared/node_modules backend/dist frontend-platform/.next frontend-academy/.next

author: Academy Platform Team
